title: Lesson schedule and the fifty-cent fee
summary: Lessons were twice a week for an hour at fifty cents. After the fourteenth lesson Metoyer waived the fee whenever Ernie knew his lesson.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: I appreciate you telling me that. I wasn't right to interrupt you. Yeah. I wanted to find out more about the lessons. How often did you go there?
Well, twice a week. Twice a week? Twice a week, yeah. And then...
About how long did they last?
An hour. One hour. And everybody charged for the lessons? Yeah, fifty cents a lesson.

Fifty cents a lesson. And after my fourteenth lesson, he promised me that every lesson that I would bring back to him, and if I knew it, I wouldn't have to pay him. For his. That's right. And he would always give my lesson, and from then on I ain't given fifty cents yet. I was fighting him. He was really tickled to death about it.
No teacher would do that nowadays.
Matter of fact it was hard to get 50 cents too at that time. That meant a good deal.
